description: status (alias get) reads the keyboard state; a visible keyboard reports returnKey and its label. Unreadable Apple keyboard state reports OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE. Enter (alias return) sends Return to the focused input; it may submit, move focus, or insert a newline, and unconfirmed delivery reports keyboard_return_unavailable with dispatched: unknown (Return may have landed). On the native iOS runner, dismiss is a no-op when the keyboard is hidden; a visible keyboard returns keyboard_dismiss_unavailable with dispatched: no. When Return would submit or finish the edit (search, go, done, send), that refusal names keyboard enter. Press the visible Hide Keyboard key or an app control that ends editing, or gesture pan down from the scrollable content with interactive dismissal, and verify with status. Android dismiss sends platform dismissal. Times out after 90s.
